blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Students at several campuses of the University of the Philippines (UP) and the Polytechnic University of the Philippines (PUP) will stage a walkout on Friday, Sept. 18, to condemn government corruption and looming budget cuts in 2027. Campus-wide walkouts are scheduled in UP’s Diliman and Los Baños campuses at 11:30 a.m. and 11 a.m., and its Mindanao campus at 2:30 p.m., according to their respective student councils’ social media. Students at the PUP’s campuses in Manila, Santo Tomas, Taguig City, Santa Rosa and Quezon City will also participate on Friday, their Office of the Student Regent announced. READ: […]...
